baseline_definitions.fixed: VERIFIED + detected + confidence>=0.9 -> AUTO_REMEDIATE; else detected -> HUMAN_REVIEW; else MONITOR_ONLY
baseline_definitions.random: Python random.Random(seed=20261020), one draw per held-out alert

split: 5 attack categories train; BenignTraffic plus 4 attack categories held out
stream: ten cached project samples; first 5 non-benign categories train, remaining 4 non-benign plus benign evaluate
approval_simulator_assumption: CONFIRM_TO_ACT is assumed approved offline so its reward can be observed; this is not live approval.
limitations: Tiny category cache, one benign row, category-level split only; no generalization or statistical significance claim.
